lede: Mountain Village Council meets October 15 with two housing authority items that actually matter — second reading of an ordinance changing how MVHA fees are set in the municipal code, paired with a resolution adopting the 2027 fee schedules for Village Court and beyond. Elsewhere, the Town of Telluride spends three hours Tuesday working through its 2027 budget, including affordable housing and open space funds, and the Ouray County Commissioners take up Proposition 123 affordable housing commitments and a Special Use Permit amendment on Tuesday as well. The Telluride Horror Show rolls in Friday through Sunday at the Sheridan, and Monday there's a Ballot Measure 5A information meeting worth knowing about.
